title: Reasoning Beyond Language: A Comprehensive Survey on Latent Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2505.16782v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on complex tasks through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, conventional CoT relies on explicitly verbalized intermediate steps, which constrains its broader applicability, particularly in abstract reasoning tasks beyond language. To address this, there has been growing research interest in \textit{latent CoT reasoning}, where the reasoning process is embedded within latent spaces. By decoupling reasoning from explicit language generation, latent CoT offers the promise of richer cognitive representations and facilitates more flexible, faster inference. This paper aims to present a comprehensive overview of this emerging paradigm and establish a systematic taxonomy. We analyze recent advances in methods, categorizing them from token-wise horizontal approaches to layer-wise vertical strategies. translated_title: 超越语言的推理：潜在思维链推理的全面综述
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过思维链（CoT）推理在复杂任务上展现出令人瞩目的性能。然而，传统思维链依赖于显式语言化的中间步骤，这限制了其更广泛的适用性，尤其是在超越语言的抽象推理任务中。为解决这一问题，潜在思维链推理日益受到研究关注，该范式将推理过程嵌入潜在空间之中。通过将推理与显式语言生成解耦，潜在思维链有望提供更丰富的认知表征，并促进更灵活、更快速的推理。本文旨在对这一新兴范式进行全面概述，并建立一个系统化的分类体系。我们分析了方法的最新进展，将其从逐token的水平方法到逐层的垂直策略进行分类，并对这些方法进行了深入讨论。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了潜在思维链推理这一新兴范式，建立了从逐token水平方法到逐层垂直策略的分类体系，展示了将推理过程嵌入潜在空间以解耦语言生成、实现更丰富认知表征和更快速推理的前景。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the emerging paradigm of latent chain-of-thought reasoning, establishing a systematic taxonomy from token-wise horizontal to layer-wise vertical approaches, which decouples reasoning from explicit language generation to enable richer cognitive representations and faster inference.
